modules.name: geflipper
modules.gap: Supported local execution includes finite configured-list/percentage buys and explicit suggested-price sell plans. The sell plan persists parent/round intent before mutation, recovers current escrow before later prices, relists only unsold owned units after settlement/bank return, sums native per-offer tax and audits consecutive all-assets/gear ledgers. Bounds include1..8 prices, lot1..24, floor, reserve, deadline, fill wait, tick cap, actor/server ownership and scalar original-life/HP. Finish lists an explicit owned lot or preserves a freshly observed identified resting sell; unfilled item escrow and collectible proceeds are separate from settled/banked results. Stop cleanup never overrides fatal-life/HP gates. Terminal settled replay performs no SDK actions; resting replay needs fresh private identity/progress. Donor FlipperScript reads price/quantity advice from the external Copilot service; its price-selection algorithm is not present in the pinned donor bundle. Local native execution does not require invented portfolio or profit prediction. The recorded price-plan/Finish, default-seller and buy-list native cases pass exact saved audits; other plans/configurations remain unqualified. No outside-demand, liquidity, realised-profit or live-repeat claim.
